content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Selling digital products without Teachable or Stripe requires a deep understanding of infrastructure architecture. It's not just a matter of finding a workaround or using a different platform. Instead, it's about building a custom solution that meets your specific needs and complies with the unique regulations of your country. This approach is often referred to as 'infrastructure sovereignty,' where the customer owns and controls their own infrastructure, free from the constraints of third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this infrastructure is the use of Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. These tools provide a high level of customization and control, allowing you to build a tailored solution that meets your specific requirements. Additionally, Supabase is used for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, providing a robust and scalable infrastructure. The payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed for digital creators who are looking for a reliable and secure way to sell their products, regardless of their location. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, this solution provides a permanent structural alternative to Teachable and Stripe, giving you full control over your infrastructure and payment processing. By using this approach, you can avoid the risks associated with platform restrictions and create a sustainable business model that meets your needs.
The Edge Commerce Stack is a pre-configured architecture that provides a permanent structural alternative to Teachable and Stripe.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack, a $197 solution, is a pre-configured architecture that combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours and includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. It also comes with 30-day support, providing peace of mind and flexibility. By using this stack, you can quickly and easily deploy a custom solution that meets your specific needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, follow these concrete steps. First, choose the Edge Commerce Stack or build your own custom solution using the individual components. Next, configure your payment processing with NOWPayments and set up your order storage with Supabase. Finally, host your products on Cloudflare Pages and deliver them through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By following these steps, you can create a permanent structural alternative to Teachable and Stripe, giving you full control over your infrastructure and payment processing.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
This solution gives you full control over your infrastructure and payment processing, providing a sustainable business model that meets your requirements.
